Record Class SecuritySearchResult

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
grafioschtrader.connector.securitysearch.SecuritySearchResult
Record Components:
providerId - id of the provider that was asked
status - outcome of the search
candidates - the candidates that do not contradict the query, best established first; empty unless the status is SecuritySearchStatus.OK
rejectedCandidates - number of candidates removed because their ISIN, currency or MIC contradicted the query
detail - short technical explanation of a failure or an empty result, may be null
otherMicCandidates - the rejected candidates whose only contradiction is an established MIC other than the queried one. They are never offered, but tell the user that the instrument may be listed on another exchange than the one chosen.
public record SecuritySearchResult(String providerId, SecuritySearchStatus status, List<SecuritySearchCandidateDto> candidates, int rejectedCandidates, String detail, List<SecuritySearchCandidateDto> otherMicCandidates) extends Record
Result of one provider search. Ambiguous or incomplete candidates are kept for the caller to resolve; nothing here picks the first one.

    • uniqueCandidateOnMic

      public Optional<SecuritySearchCandidateDto> uniqueCandidateOnMic(String mic, String tickerHint)
      Returns the only candidate listed on the given exchange, as needed for an automatic resolution. A candidate counts only when the provider established its MIC. When several remain, the ticker hint may narrow them to the one whose provider symbol is the ticker itself or the ticker followed by an exchange suffix (NOVN.SW rather than NOVNEE.SW).
      Parameters:
      mic - MIC of the exchange
      tickerHint - ticker of the instrument, may be null
      Returns:
      the candidate, or empty when there is none or the choice stays ambiguous
